subject: mathematics
name: Adding denominators directly
plain_language_label: You added the denominators, but they show different-sized parts.
plain_language_label_bm: Anda menambah penyebut, tetapi penyebut menunjukkan bahagian yang berlainan saiz.
remediation_approach: Use fraction strips to show that parts must be the same size before adding, then find a common denominator.

subject: mathematics
name: Ignoring the common denominator requirement
plain_language_label: Make the pieces the same size before you add or subtract fractions.
plain_language_label_bm: Samakan saiz bahagian sebelum anda menambah atau menolak pecahan.
remediation_approach: Model equivalent fractions with visual bars and practise rewriting both fractions with a shared denominator.

subject: mathematics
name: Unable to generate equivalent fractions
plain_language_label: Multiply or divide the top and bottom by the same number to keep the value equal.
plain_language_label_bm: Darab atau bahagi pengangka dan penyebut dengan nombor yang sama supaya nilainya kekal sama.
remediation_approach: Use shaded shapes and a multiply-by-one pattern, such as 1/2 x 2/2 = 2/4, before moving to symbolic practice.

subject: mathematics
name: Multiplying when adding fractions
plain_language_label: Multiplying fractions is a different operation from adding them.
plain_language_label_bm: Mendarab pecahan ialah operasi yang berbeza daripada menambah pecahan.
remediation_approach: Contrast area models for multiplication with fraction-strip models for addition, then ask students to name the operation before solving.

subject: mathematics
name: Subtracting the larger numerator from the smaller numerator
name_bm: Menolak pengangka yang lebih besar daripada pengangka yang lebih kecil
plain_language_label: Keep the order of subtraction and use a visual model when the result is negative or needs regrouping.
plain_language_label_bm: Kekalkan tertib penolakan dan gunakan model visual apabila jawapannya negatif atau perlu dikumpulkan semula.
remediation_approach: Use number lines and fraction bars to represent the starting amount and what is removed; practise same-denominator subtraction before regrouping.

subject: mathematics
name: Unable to simplify fractions using common factors
name_bm: Tidak dapat memudahkan pecahan menggunakan faktor sepunya
plain_language_label: Divide the top and bottom by the same common factor.
plain_language_label_bm: Bahagi pengangka dan penyebut dengan faktor sepunya yang sama.
remediation_approach: List factor pairs for the numerator and denominator, identify a common factor, and connect simplification to making an equivalent fraction.

subject: mathematics
name: Unable to convert mixed numbers to improper fractions
name_bm: Tidak dapat menukar nombor bercampur kepada pecahan tak wajar
plain_language_label: Count all the equal parts in the whole numbers, then add the extra fraction.
plain_language_label_bm: Kira semua bahagian sama dalam nombor bulat, kemudian tambah pecahan tambahan.
remediation_approach: Draw each whole split into denominator-sized parts and use (whole number x denominator + numerator) / denominator.

subject: mathematics
name: Treating a fraction like a whole number
wrong_answer_pattern: 1/8 is considered greater than 1/4 because 8 is greater than 4
plain_language_label: With the same top number, more equal parts means each part is smaller.
plain_language_label_bm: Apabila pengangkanya sama, lebih banyak bahagian yang sama bermaksud setiap bahagian lebih kecil.
remediation_approach: Compare shaded wholes divided into different numbers of equal parts and connect the denominator to part size.

subject: mathematics
name: Misaligning decimal place values
plain_language_label: Line up the decimal points so ones, tenths, and hundredths stay in their columns.
plain_language_label_bm: Jajarkan titik perpuluhan supaya sa, persepuluh dan perseratus kekal dalam lajur masing-masing.
remediation_approach: Use a place-value chart and require decimal points to be aligned before students add or subtract.

subject: mathematics
name: Comparing decimals by digit count instead of value
name_bm: Membandingkan perpuluhan mengikut bilangan digit, bukan nilai
plain_language_label: Compare the value in each place, starting with tenths; add zeros if it helps.
plain_language_label_bm: Bandingkan nilai pada setiap tempat, bermula dengan persepuluh; tambah sifar jika membantu.
remediation_approach: Write equivalent forms such as 0.90 and 0.12 on a place-value chart and locate them on a number line.

subject: mathematics
name: Not adjusting decimal places when multiplying
name_bm: Tidak melaraskan tempat perpuluhan semasa mendarab
plain_language_label: Estimate first, then place the decimal so your answer has a sensible size.
plain_language_label_bm: Anggarkan dahulu, kemudian letakkan titik perpuluhan supaya saiz jawapan munasabah.
remediation_approach: Use area models and estimation with tenths, then connect the model to counting decimal places in the factors.

subject: mathematics
name: Dropping the leading zero in a decimal
plain_language_label: Write a zero before the decimal point when the value is less than one.
plain_language_label_bm: Tulis sifar sebelum titik perpuluhan apabila nilainya kurang daripada satu.
remediation_approach: Read decimals aloud with a place-value chart and reinforce that the zero shows there are no whole ones.

subject: mathematics
name: Unable to convert between decimal and fraction form
name_bm: Tidak dapat menukar antara bentuk perpuluhan dan pecahan
plain_language_label: Use the decimal place to choose the denominator: tenths, hundredths, or thousandths.
plain_language_label_bm: Gunakan tempat perpuluhan untuk memilih penyebut: persepuluh, perseratus atau perseribu.
remediation_approach: Match decimal grids, place-value names, and fractions over powers of ten, then simplify when appropriate.

subject: mathematics
name: Treating a percentage as a whole number
plain_language_label: Percent means out of 100, so convert it to a fraction or decimal before calculating.
plain_language_label_bm: Peratus bermaksud daripada 100, jadi tukarkannya kepada pecahan atau perpuluhan sebelum mengira.
remediation_approach: Use a 100-square grid and practise translating common percentages into decimals and fractions.

subject: mathematics
name: Using an incorrect percentage-of calculation method
name_bm: Menggunakan kaedah pengiraan peratus daripada yang salah
plain_language_label: Change the percent to a decimal, then multiply by the whole amount.
plain_language_label_bm: Tukarkan peratus kepada perpuluhan, kemudian darab dengan jumlah keseluruhan.
remediation_approach: Use bar models labelled as 100% and connect finding a percentage of an amount to decimal multiplication.

subject: mathematics
name: Unable to calculate percentage increase correctly
name_bm: Tidak dapat mengira peningkatan peratus dengan betul
plain_language_label: Find the change, divide by the original amount, then multiply by 100.
plain_language_label_bm: Cari perubahan, bahagi dengan jumlah asal, kemudian darab dengan 100.
remediation_approach: Use before-and-after bar models and explicitly label the original value as the reference whole before applying the formula.

subject: mathematics
name: Unable to convert between percentage and fraction form
name_bm: Tidak dapat menukar antara bentuk peratus dan pecahan
plain_language_label: Write the percent over 100, then simplify the fraction if possible.
plain_language_label_bm: Tulis peratus di atas 100, kemudian mudahkan pecahan jika boleh.
remediation_approach: Use percent strips and a conversion table linking percentages, fractions, and decimals for familiar benchmark values.

subject: mathematics
name: Believing percentages cannot exceed 100 percent
name_bm: Mempercayai peratus tidak boleh melebihi 100 peratus
wrong_answer_pattern: 150% is marked impossible because percentages stop at 100%
plain_language_label: More than 100% means more than one whole.
plain_language_label_bm: Lebih daripada 100% bermaksud lebih daripada satu keseluruhan.
remediation_approach: Use double number lines and real examples such as a 150% increase to connect percentages above 100% with values greater than one.
